description: Read additions, amendments and removals observed between official OFAC SDN/Consolidated, UK and EU list snapshots. Use this for monitoring; sanctions_search_entries finds current names and sanctions_get_entry retrieves a known current id. Filters narrow together. Returns changes with entry, changed fields, observed_at, proof (official file URL, SHA-256, source date), lists check times and next_cursor. Reuse next_cursor with the same filters to page or poll; no changes means no observed changes, not clearance. The UN list is excluded; official publications are authoritative. Free keyless allowance: 100 successful answers/day when metered, unlimited otherwise. API keys retain their credit policy. No MCP payment flow; exhaustion returns the HTTP alternative.

change.description: One kind of change only Allowed: added, amended, removed; e.g. added.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; s followed by 1 to 12 digits, e.g. s0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

list.description: One list only Allowed: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, uk, eu; e.g. ofac-sdn.

since.description: Changes observed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago); e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

name: sanctions_list_changes
title: List sanctions listing changes
